newsHighlights.title: APEC ministers eye greater cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: APEC ministers met to seek closer economic cooperation and stronger regional partnerships, showing that dialogue remains the key tool for solving shared problems.
newsHighlights.translation: 亚太经合组织部长级会议寻求更深入的经济合作与更紧密的区域伙伴关系，这表明对话仍是解决共同问题的关键工具。

newsHighlights.title: China-Europe freight train service marks milestone
newsHighlights.summary: A China-Europe freight train bound for Moscow departed Shenyang on Thursday, pushing the service's cumulative trips past 140,000 and carrying goods across the continent.
newsHighlights.translation: 一列开往莫斯科的中欧班列周四从沈阳发出，使该服务累计开行突破14万列，货物跨越欧亚大陆。

newsHighlights.title: Shenzhen, a high-tech city serving people
newsHighlights.summary: Shenzhen is often called a cyberpunk city, but unlike the 'high tech, low life' of science fiction, its technology is designed to serve ordinary people.
newsHighlights.translation: 深圳常被称为“赛博朋克”城市，但与科幻作品中的“高科技、低生活”不同，它的技术是为普通人服务的。

newsHighlights.title: China to steadily expand intelligent connected vehicle applications
newsHighlights.summary: China announced plans to steadily expand the use of intelligent connected vehicles, an initiative that will require close coordination between companies and regulators.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国宣布将稳步推进智能网联汽车应用，这项倡议需要企业与监管机构之间的密切协作。

quote.quote: The art of communication is the language of leadership.
quote.author: James Humes
quote.translation: 沟通的艺术，就是领导力的语言。
quote.explanation: 真正的领导力不是发号施令，而是把复杂的想法说清楚、让团队愿意一起行动。APEC 部长们推动合作、中欧班列牵动无数合同与邮件，背后靠的都是清晰而真诚的沟通。

vocabulary.translation: 亚太经合组织部长们寻求更深入的合作，以保持区域贸易增长。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 "APEC ministers eye greater cooperation"。

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "China-Europe freight train service marks milestone"。

vocabulary.translation: 自开行以来，该服务的累计班次已超过14万列。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻中 "bringing the service's cumulative trips to top 140,000"。

vocabulary.translation: 深圳作为中国的创新中心之一，以把想法变成产品而闻名。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Shenzhen, a high-tech city serving people" 中 "one of China's innovation hubs"。

vocabulary.translation: 中国将稳步推进智能网联汽车应用的扩展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "China to steadily expand intelligent connected vehicle applications"。

vocabulary.translation: 这项新倡议需要每个部门的支持才能成功。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "China to steadily expand intelligent connected vehicle applications" 中的政策倡议。

vocabulary.example: Delegates at the APEC meeting shared views on how to boost regional growth.

vocabulary.example: Companies along the China-Europe route negotiate contracts in different time zones every day.

vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "China-Europe freight train service marks milestone" 中跨国贸易往来的沟通场景。

vocabulary.example: The ministers reached a consensus on closer economic cooperation.
vocabulary.translation: 部长们就深化经济合作达成了共识。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "APEC ministers eye greater cooperation" 的会议成果描述。

vocabulary.example: A Shanghai studio brings Chinese icons to the world through international collaboration.
vocabulary.translation: 上海一家工作室通过国际合作把中国文化符号带向世界。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Shanghai studio brings Chinese icons to the world"。

pattern.pattern: eye + (greater/more) + 名词：表示“着眼于、寻求（更大的……）”，常用于新闻标题与职场目标表述
pattern.translation: 亚太经合组织部长们寻求更深入的合作。
pattern.usage: eye 在此作动词，意为“关注、谋求”。职场中可用于描述团队目标，例如 "Our team eyes greater efficiency this quarter."（我们团队本季度着眼于更高效率。）也可替换名词：eye closer ties（谋求更紧密的联系）、eye new markets（瞄准新市场）。

grammar.title: 现在分词作结果状语（Present Participle as a Result Adverbial）
grammar.explanation: 英语新闻中常用 "doing..." 现在分词短语放在句尾，补充说明前句动作带来的自然结果，相当于 "and this brings/leads to..."。使用时分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。
examples: A China-Europe freight train bound for Moscow departed Puhe station in Shenyang, bringing the service's cumulative trips to top 140,000.
Macron called for a halt to demonstrations in the coming days, urging citizens to stay calm.

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第三个音节 -ra- 上：co-o-PE-ra-tion。前两个音节要轻读、连读得快，/əʊ/ 与 /ɒ/ 之间自然过渡；结尾 -tion 发 /ʃn/，不要读成“提翁”。可拆解练习：koh-OP-uh-RAY-shun，再加速连读。
examples: Good results come from close cooperation between teams.

reading.title: Talk First, Build Together: Lessons in Workplace Communication
reading.content:
When APEC ministers met this week to eye greater cooperation, they were doing what every successful team does: talking first, acting together. Their meeting is a useful lesson for anyone working in a modern office, because progress rarely comes from one person alone.

The same message appears in trade news. On Thursday, a China-Europe freight train left Shenyang for Moscow, pushing the service's cumulative trips past 140,000. Behind that number are thousands of emails, contracts and phone calls between partners in different cities and time zones.

Good workplace communication is not about using big words. It is about being clear, listening carefully and following up. Leaders who state goals plainly, invite questions and confirm decisions in writing help their teams move faster and make fewer mistakes.

In a connected world, cooperation is a practical skill. Whether you are a minister at a summit or a new employee in a meeting room, the rule is the same: speak clearly, listen patiently, and build trust one conversation at a time.
reading.translation:
本周亚太经合组织部长们开会寻求更深入的合作，他们所做的正是每个成功团队的做法：先沟通，再共同行动。这场会议对任何在现代职场工作的人都有启发，因为进步很少来自单打独斗。

同样的道理也体现在经贸新闻中。周四，一列中欧班列从沈阳开往莫斯科，使累计班次突破14万列。这个数字背后，是身处不同城市、不同时区的伙伴之间成千上万封邮件、合同与电话。

好的职场沟通不在于使用华丽的辞藻，而在于表达清晰、认真倾听并及时跟进。能够清楚说明目标、欢迎提问、并以书面形式确认决定的领导者，能帮助团队更快推进、减少失误。

在一个紧密相连的世界里，合作是一项实用技能。无论你是峰会上的部长，还是会议室里的新人，规则都一样：说清楚、耐心听，用一次一次的对话积累信任。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026-10-23 ChinaDaily《APEC ministers eye greater cooperation》与《China-Europe freight train service marks milestone》两则真实新闻改写，用于英语学习目的。
